tool_input.summary: Calories were well controlled -- 1720 against a 1774 target is essentially on the number. The gap is protein: 44g against your 140g goal, because every meal was carb-led. Swapping the jam toast for eggs, adding chicken to the pasta and using a lentil or paneer curry would have closed most of that for similar calories.
tool_input.progress_note: On a cut, consistently hitting a third of your protein target is the main risk to the muscle you are trying to keep. Calorie control is clearly not your problem, so fixing protein is the single change that would move your results most.
